EVAL-F-03-S101.title: Define EvaluateCare Facade Request/Response Contracts
EVAL-F-03-S101.description: Establish explicit request and response schemas for evaluate care facade methods, aligning with existing Pydantic tool models for clinical trials and ensuring consistent, structured outputs for downstream consumption.

EVAL-F-03-S102.title: Normalize Facade Response Formatting for Chat Output
EVAL-F-03-S102.description: Implement standardized formatting of facade outputs (clinical trials and provider details) to ensure consistent structure, link handling, and downstream rendering compatibility in chat responses.

EVAL-F-03-S103.title: Implement Error Handling and Fallback Logic in Facade
EVAL-F-03-S103.description: Add structured error handling within evaluate_care_facade to manage API failures, empty results, and partial data scenarios, ensuring safe fallback responses and no unhandled exceptions reach the tool layer.

EVAL-F-03-S104.title: Integrate Debug Logging and Traceability in Facade
EVAL-F-03-S104.description: Instrument evaluate_care_facade with debug logging for request inputs, service calls, and outputs using existing debug_logger to support traceability, auditing, and troubleshooting.
